purpose: Source of truth for the Odoo data model that backs the GoSwing app once Supabase is decommissioned. Every Odoo model on this list is needed; the field lists are exhaustive (the existing app reads/writes them all).

conventions.model_prefix: All models are namespaced under `goswing.` (e.g. `goswing.event`). Underlying Postgres tables auto-derive from the dotted name with dots → underscores (e.g. `goswing_event`).
conventions.id_strategy: Odoo's int `id` is internal-only and NEVER returned to the RN client. Every model has an `external_id` Char field (the original Supabase UUID, unique, indexed, required). The API surfaces `external_id` as the `id` field in JSON.
conventions.user_identity: Every user-scoped table has `clerk_user_id` (Char, index=True). This is the Clerk JWT `sub` claim, populated by the controller from the verified JWT, never from request body. This is the replacement for Supabase RLS — every controller method enforces ownership against this column.
conventions.name_normalization: Some Supabase tables use `user_id` for the Clerk identity, others use `clerk_user_id`. On Odoo, normalize ALL of them to `clerk_user_id`. The original Supabase column name is recorded in `supabase_column` for migration scripts.
conventions.external_id_collision: The Supabase `events` table has a column called `external_id` (text alias like `evt_005`). On Odoo this is renamed to `slug` to free `external_id` for the UUID. The API exposes the slug as the JSON field `externalId`.
conventions.currency: Supabase stored `currency` as `character` (length 1) — that is a bug. On Odoo, store as Char(size=3), default 'USD', uppercase ISO 4217.
conventions.timestamps: All datetime columns in UTC. Odoo `fields.Datetime` is naive UTC by default — that's correct. JSON serialization adds trailing `Z`.
conventions.vestigial_columns_dropped: The Supabase tables include columns named `odoo_model`, `odoo_id`, `last_synced_at`, `sync_state`, `last_sync_error` from a previous, abandoned bidirectional-sync attempt. These DO NOT exist on Odoo — drop them on migration.

type_mapping.uuid: Char(size=36, index=True). For the row's primary public id, the field name is `external_id`. For UUID foreign keys see `many2one` below — store the relation as Many2one to the target Odoo model and resolve via `external_id`.
type_mapping.text: Char (no size cap) or Text — Char is fine for short strings, Text for descriptions.
type_mapping.time without time zone: Char(size=5) holding `HH:MM` — there's no native Time field in Odoo; alternatively Float (e.g. 14.5 = 14:30) but Char is clearer.
type_mapping.jsonb: Json (Odoo 15+). Falls back to Text + JSON serialization on older versions.
type_mapping.ARRAY (text[]): Char with comma-joined values, OR a separate one2many model. Where it appears in this schema (`organizers.specialties`), treat as Char with comma-joined values for now — low write volume.
type_mapping.character (length 1) → currency: Char(size=3). Fix legacy data on migration: `'$' → 'USD'` etc.
type_mapping.many2one: Use `Many2one` with `comodel_name` set. The DB foreign key is on the relation column. Set `ondelete` to match the Supabase FK behavior (default RESTRICT — see per-field notes for SET NULL / CASCADE).
type_mapping.primary_key: Odoo gives every model an int PK automatically. We add `external_id` Char as the public id.

default_value_tokens.gen_random_uuid(): Generate in the controller on `create` if not supplied (e.g. `str(uuid.uuid4())`). On data migration, preserve the original Supabase UUID.
default_value_tokens.requesting_user_id() | (auth.jwt() ->> ': Set in the controller from the verified JWT `sub`. NEVER from request body.

models.description: A scheduled event (the core entity). Sold via ticket_types; hosted by an organizer at a venue.
models.ownership: organizer_member (creators are members of the organizer; reads are public for status='published').

fields.name: external_id
fields.help: Public UUID. The RN client uses this as the event id.

fields.name: slug
fields.help: Optional human-readable alias (e.g. 'evt_005'). Renamed from Supabase `external_id` to avoid collision.

fields.name: category
fields.help: Free-form category slug (e.g. 'rooftop', 'club').

fields.name: currency
fields.help: ISO 4217 (3 letters). Fix legacy data on migration.

fields.name: min_price_cents
fields.help: Cached cheapest ticket-type price across all ticket_types for this event. Recomputed when ticket_types change.

fields.name: attendee_count
fields.help: Cached count of distinct users with confirmed/completed reservations. Server-recomputed; never from client.

fields.name: policies
fields.help: Array of policy strings shown on the event page.

fields.name: created_by_clerk_user_id
fields.help: Clerk JWT `sub` of the creator. Populated from JWT on create.

fields.name: tag_ids
fields.help: Through `goswing.event_tag` to `goswing.tag`.

models.description: An organization that hosts events.

fields.name: country_code
fields.help: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

fields.name: specialties
fields.help: Comma-joined list. Was `text[]` in Supabase.

fields.name: custom_policies
fields.help: Array of policy strings.

models.description: A physical location.

fields.name: timezone
fields.help: IANA tz (e.g. 'America/New_York').

fields.name: organizer_id
fields.help: Optional 1:1 — venues that are owned/operated by an organizer.

models.description: Taxonomy tag. `type` partitions tags into buckets (category / access / music / party).
M:N join — events ↔ tags. Standalone model (not pure m2m) because of `created_at`.
User → favorited event. Owner = clerk_user_id.
models.ownership: record_owner (writes only by the user; reads only by the user).

fields.name: clerk_user_id
fields.help: Populated from JWT `sub`.

models.description: Soft RSVP / interest signal (not a paid reservation).
Images/videos curated for an event by its organizer.
User-submitted review of an event.
models.ownership: record_owner for write/delete; reads are public (per event).

indexes.name: uq_event_review_per_user
indexes.note: One review per user per event.

models.description: User-submitted review of a venue.
models.ownership: record_owner for write/delete; reads are public.

models.description: User-submitted song suggestion for an event (Deezer-backed).

indexes.name: uq_song_suggestion
indexes.note: One user can't suggest the same track twice for the same event.

models.description: User-uploaded photo for an event. Auto-expires after 24h. Photo storage decision pending — see README § 10.
models.ownership: record_owner for write/delete; reads are public per event.

fields.name: photo_url
fields.help: Public URL. Either an `ir.attachment` URL (option A) or external CDN URL (option B).

fields.name: expires_at
fields.help: Server-set on create. Expired rows hidden from queries; pruned by daily cron.

models.description: User → followed organizer.
Images/videos curated by an organizer for their profile.
Users who can act on behalf of an organizer (admin / staff).
models.ownership: organizer admins manage their own membership list.

models.description: Payment / withdrawal methods for an organizer (e.g. Stripe Connect account).
M:N join — organizers ↔ tags.
User profile (one per Clerk user).

fields.name: clerk_user_id
fields.help: Acts as the public id for profile reads — there is no separate UUID.

models.description: Per-user app-level settings (one row per user).
Per-user push/email/SMS toggles.

fields.name: quiet_hours_start
fields.help: HH:MM

fields.name: quiet_hours_end
fields.help: HH:MM

models.description: User → tag (interests for personalization).
Append-only login attempts. Read-only from the RN client.
Saved cards / payment methods for a user.
Buyable ticket category for an event (e.g. 'GA', 'VIP').

fields.name: benefits
fields.help: Array of benefit strings.

fields.name: capacity
fields.help: Inventory limit (null = unlimited).

models.description: An order. Created in `draft`, moves to `confirmed` after payment, then `completed` after the event.
models.ownership: record_owner for read/write of own reservation.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.help: If set, draft reservations auto-cancel after this time.

models.description: Line item on a reservation: N tickets of one ticket_type. Snapshots fields so prices are stable post-purchase.

fields.name: ticket_type_name_snapshot
fields.help: Name of the ticket type at purchase time.

fields.name: benefits_snapshot
fields.help: Benefits array at purchase time.

models.description: An individual ticket (one row per attendee). Carries the QR data.

fields.name: ticket_no
fields.help: Sequence number within the reservation (1, 2, 3, ...).

fields.name: ticket_code
fields.help: Public code printed on the ticket.

fields.name: qr_secret_hash
fields.help: Hash of the QR signing secret. Server-only.

models.description: Per-ticket attendee details captured at checkout.
Alternate / extended attendee profile per ticket. (Schema duplicates ticket_holders somewhat — keep both for now, audit later.)
Append-only log of QR scans at the door.
Payment intents for a reservation. Written by Stripe webhook handler (out of scope for now — see README § 11).
Scheduled / completed payouts to organizers.
Apple Wallet / Google Wallet pass URL for a ticket.
